claim: Changes to a web ACL or other AWS WAF resources take a small amount of time to propagate, from a few seconds to a number of minutes; for example, after you add a rule group to a web ACL, the new rule group rules might be in effect in one area where the web ACL is used and not in another.

evidence.quote: When you create or change a protection pack (web ACL) or other AWS WAF resources, the changes take a small amount of time to propagate to all areas where the resources are stored. The propagation time can be from a few seconds to a number of minutes.
After you add a rule group to a protection pack (web ACL), the new rule group rules might be in effect in one area where the protection pack (web ACL) is used and not in another.
